title: Outstandingly Peppery Norwegian Bacon Skewers
description: A show-off Norwegian dish featuring peppery bacon, double-fry KFC style, and paleo-friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe is sure to impress with its shattering crispy exterior and flavorful interior.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt.
Cut the bacon slices into 1 inch pieces and toss in the pepper mixture to coat.
Thread 3-4 pieces of bacon onto each skewer.
Dip each skewer into the egg wash and then coat in almond flour.
Heat the coconut oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Double fry the skewers, first frying at 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes and then increasing the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit for an additional 2 minutes.
Place the fried skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
